title: The radial leakage one-form is nonclosed across unequal charges and its normal-form divisor loses two derivatives

radial_obstruction.two_charge_coordinates: For charge sectors q,r with |q|!=|r| set x=|phi_q|^2, y=|phi_r|^2, M0=x+y and Mn=q^(2n)x+r^(2n)y
radial_obstruction.one_form: A derivative-free quartic correction would require dV=(lambda/2) M0 dMn, equivalently dW=-(lambda/2) Mn dM0 after removing one total derivative
radial_obstruction.curl: d(M0 dMn)=dM0 wedge dMn=(r^(2n)-q^(2n)) dx wedge dy, which is nonzero for n>=1 and unequal absolute charges
radial_obstruction.density_no_go: No derivative-free gauge-invariant quartic density cancels the K1413 radial leakage on the full multi-charge support
radial_obstruction.small_divisor: For free standing waves with omega_q(K)=sqrt(K^2+m^2+mu q^2), the antisymmetric homological divisor is omega_q-omega_r and (omega_q+omega_r)/(omega_q-omega_r) grows as 4K^2/(mu(q^2-r^2))
radial_obstruction.derivative_cost: Any time-local quartic normal form solving this cross-charge homological equation loses two spatial derivatives and cannot be a bounded same-tier correction
radial_obstruction.scope: The result leaves scalar-Q^(2n) support, derivative-losing higher tiers, spacetime estimates, null forms and summable hierarchies open
